title: Barinthus Biotherapeutics plc 8-K Filing — Departure of Directors and Appointment of CFO
summary: Barinthus Biotherapeutics plc, a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company traded on Nasdaq under ticker BRNS, filed an 8-K on April 22, 2026 announcing the appointment of Douglas Swirsky as Chief Financial Officer and principal accounting officer, effective May 1, 2026. Swirsky, 56, will serve via a master services agreement with Grand Strand BioAdvisors LLC at a rate of $20,000 per month. This is a routine corporate governance filing with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Douglas Swirsky appointed CFO and principal accounting officer effective May 1, 2026
Swirsky previously served as CFO at MaxCyte, Inc. from March 2023 to March 2026
Compensation structure: $20,000 per month through Grand Strand BioAdvisors LLC
Company is an emerging growth company as defined under SEC Rule 405/12b-2
Trading on Nasdaq Global Market under ticker BRNS (American Depositary Shares)
